scope: Original joint installed E1–E4 technical candidate plus real autonomous selection, source-checked result, original private delivery and bounded later use. Not whole project or family acceptance.

laterUse.selfChosenUsefulConcreteWork: satisfied for this ordinary episode; no operator-selected topic or resume
laterUse.checkedRetainedResultToCorrectPrivateRec: satisfied at the retained receipt plus independent source-audit level, with semantic/physical limits explicit
laterUse.laterOrdinaryUseAndAppropriateContinuati: satisfied in bounded form: the exact result-bound next ordinary review used the real observed state and change time, declined unsupported duration assertions and chose not to repeat recently completed/delivered work. This is substantive source use, not merely restating task status.
laterUse.noMandatorySecondTaskOrNewMessage: A valid following decision can be silence. The original criterion does not require fabricated extra work or redundant contact.
laterUse.limits: This is an immediate subsequent ordinary decision, not proof of cross-day interests, later learned improvement or repeated daily benefit.

currentCandidateReuse.currentRelevantSourceDelta: Later core-only helper change extends description-prefix fallback; the catalog policy adds two read-only actions. Neither changes the household selection/result-reader/execution route used in this episode. Existing five-field release and unchanged worker provenance support reuse without a fresh run.
currentCandidateReuse.noRetroactiveReadmission: Read old immutable evidence under current owner authority; do not attach the new mandate to the old work or authorize replay.
currentCandidateReuse.causalTiming: Episode completed/delivered before the 08:05 catalog policy admission. It is a different ordinary lane from the later private idle silence.
